<!-- Feature request to an outside vendor, filed through that vendor's public channel (issue tracker,
     community forum, feedback form). Write it the way any API customer would: describe what you need the API
     to do for you, not how the vendor should build it. No vendor internals, no patches to non-public code.
     A person reviews and files it. -->

## What I'm trying to do

One or two sentences about the user-facing goal, in the project's terms. Example: "Analysts using our Splunk
add-on want to see when a domain was first reported, next to the notable event."

## What's missing today

What you tried with the public API, the call and arguments you used, and what you got back.

## What would help

What you'd like to call and what you'd like back, at the level of the public interface (inputs, outputs,
limits). If an existing call almost does it, say which one and what's missing.

## How we'll cope without it

What the project does today if this never ships (another provider, a degraded mode, nothing). This keeps
the request a nice-to-have, not a dependency.

## Project

Name and link of the SecAI84 project (MIT, open source).
